newspec-c: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue))
Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. The task extractor is a rule-based stand-in that can only find what the app sends it (args.content / args.openTasks), so the app's own request, cut, merge and storage are what is judged, not the model. Spec ext-tc22-s01-s03-uat-flow.spec.ts, judged 2/4. After Save Note on the Nursing Home pre-round with 'Follow up BMP. PT eval. Recheck weight in two weeks.' the page made one model call, ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes, and no ai/parsing:extractTasks; Post-Round → tasks says 'No tasks yet.' / '0 pending tasks' and nothing is stored. Because no request is ever sent, no model can change this (useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts has no task call, unchanged since e02167f), so it is judged here, not on dev. Against UAT TC-22 step 4 (repeat steps 1–3 in Nursing Home), TFA-92588 AC 10 ('Pre-round tasks appear in the task list', no context named) and TFA-92592 AC 14. Open question Q3: the p72 prototype comment above TASK_SYSTEM_PROMPT says pre-round task extraction was removed by design ('at the computer you just place the order yourself'), while the Hospital pre-round on main does harvest tasks.
Product issue: Nursing Home: a physician who dictates follow-ups in the pre-round note ('Follow up BMP. PT eval. Recheck weight in two weeks.') gets no tasks at all — the task list stays 'No tasks yet.'; the Hospital pre-round with the same text makes them.

descriptionHtml:
Candidate N23 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Nursing Home pre-round tasks never appear: Save Note sends no task request, so the list stays 'No tasks yet.'

Tickets: TFA-92588 AC 10 / TFA-92592 AC 14 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S02 Nursing Home, UAT step 1: tasks dictated in the pre-round appear on the task list

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th … (UAT TC-22 step 1; TFA-92588 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician, Nursing Home resident from the fixture, no tasks

When Type the three UAT tasks into the Nursing Home pre-round notes and tap Save Note; open Post-Round → Tasks

Then Three open tasks: follow up BMP, PT eval, recheck weight in two weeks

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT step 4 applied to step 1 (and TFA-92588 AC 10): '3 pending tasks', not 'No tasks yet.' / '0 pending tasks'. Judged on the count only; the per-task regex waits for mustMatch in oracle.mjs and sits in pendingChecks, outside the checkpoint, so nothing is silently skipped (runnerGaps 1). On main the Nursing Home pre-round has no task call (see build), so a Fail is expected; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

Detail:

Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. The task extractor is a rule-based stand-in that can only find what the app sends it (args.content / args.openTasks), so the app's own request, cut, merge and storage are what is judged, not the model. Spec ext-tc22-s01-s03-uat-flow.spec.ts, judged 2/4. After Save Note on the Nursing Home pre-round with 'Follow up BMP. PT eval. Recheck weight in two weeks.' the page made one model call, ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes, and no ai/parsing:extractTasks; Post-Round → tasks says 'No tasks yet.' / '0 pending tasks' and nothing is stored. Because no request is ever sent, no model can change this (useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts has no task call, unchanged since e02167f), so it is judged here, not on dev. Against UAT TC-22 step 4 (repeat steps 1–3 in Nursing Home), TFA-92588 AC 10 ('Pre-round tasks appear in the task list', no context named) and TFA-92592 AC 14. Open question Q3: the p72 prototype comment above TASK_SYSTEM_PROMPT says pre-round task extraction was removed by design ('at the computer you just place the order yourself'), while the Hospital pre-round on main does harvest tasks.

Product issue: Nursing Home: a physician who dictates follow-ups in the pre-round note ('Follow up BMP. PT eval. Recheck weight in two weeks.') gets no tasks at all — the task list stays 'No tasks yet.'; the Hospital pre-round with the same text makes them.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: ticket-gate — ticket-gate: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92592 ready for pr — requirements U1, U8 gated (runnable on dev otherwise). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
